facts.fact: Birr Metrics reports the Ministry of Trade and Regional Integration moved import-export business registration to the Online Trade Registration and Licensing System, which links 745 registration offices and cut incorporation to two steps in two days.
facts.system: Online Trade Registration and Licensing System (OTRLS)

systems.system: Online Trade Registration and Licensing System (OTRLS)
systems.owner: Ministry of Trade and Regional Integration

note: Integration with the Revenue Ministry's TIN database is not stated as one number shared.
